newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps rates Hungarian Telephone notes.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps rates Hungarian Telephone notes.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it assigned a credit rating of Single B to Hungarian Telephone and Cable Corp's US$170 million secured senior credit facility.

The credit facility is guaranteed by Postabank Es Takarekpenztar Rt, and the rating applies to the Hungarian Telephone guarantee and not the subsidiary bank loans, which have a greater degree of security.
Hungarian Telephone is parent of the Hungarotel Rt, Papatel Rt, Kelet-Nograd Com Rt and Raba-Com Rt. They are local telephone operating companies in Hungary.
The facility will be used by the operating subsidiaries to repay debt and fund capital expenditures associated with network modernization.
